messages:
Maria (CS): Hey @aj, quick heads-up — CypherPay onboarding is showing p99 tail latency ~1.2s on /chat/generate during peak tests. Customer is sensitive to latency for payments flow. Thinking we should propose a short experiment: swap to the q4_8 quantized variant + route 10% to q8 for quality check. Also suggest enabling prefix KV cache for common prompts. Thoughts?

AJ (Eng): Can you paste the perf snapshot? I'm guessing it's KV cache misses and long decoding due to seq len. If we quantify, q4_8 should cut inference time ~30-35%.

Nora (CypherPay): We're seeing timeouts in integration tests. Any quick change we can flip on without a deploy?

Sam (Platform): We can push a routing policy on their tenant to route to q4_8 on hosted backend, no code change. Will need a canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Also enable prefix_cache=true for their route.

Maria (CS): Here's the snapshot link: https://redwood.internal/perf/tenant/cypherpay/2026-03-19 — key spikes around 11:25 load test. Also customer note: they care about hallucination rates.

AJ (Eng): Ok plan: 1) enable routing canary in Console with fallback to baseline; 2) swap model to q4_8; 3) set KV cache; 4) collect golden-set eval for quality. Need SLO guard: if mean_quality_drop > 1.5% rollback.

Sam (Platform): I'll schedule the canary now. On it — tagging @deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for tenant cypherpay — 5% traffic -> model q4_8 -> monitor metrics.

Maria (CS): Thanks. I'll coordinate customer enablement and prep a short rollout note for Nora. @Nora please share a small golden set (10 prompts) we can monitor.

Nora (CypherPay): Sure — sending in DM.

AJ (Eng): Quick config snippet for routing in Console: ```
route:
  tenant: cypherpay
  traffic_split:
    - model: q4_8
      pct: 5
    - model: baseline
      pct: 95
fallback: baseline
```

Sam (Platform): Canary metrics look healthy at +10m. p99 dropped from 1.2s -> 0.8s. Quality delta: +0.4% (improvement). We'll ramp to 25% in 15m unless objections.

Maria (CS): This is great. I'll mark onboarding ticket as 'perf mitigation applied' and follow up in 24h. :tada:
